articles.title: Singapore Grand Prix 2026: Race start time, how to watch, full schedule, predictions
articles.description: Formula 1's original night race is back as drivers prepare for the ultimate challenge around the Marina Bay Circuit in Singapore.

articles.title: Verstappen labels F1 paddock a 'zoo' in VIPs dig
articles.description: Max Verstappen does not want to miss his daughter growing up by racing for too long in Formula 1, a paddock he thinks now resembles a zoo due to the amount of guests and VIPs every weekend.

articles.title: Verstappen continues form with Singapore pole
articles.description: Max Verstappen has continued his dominance in Singapore after putting his Red Bull on pole position for Sunday's grand prix.

articles.title: Norris, Piastri avoid punishment on McLaren clash
articles.description: Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri's collision at the end of the Singapore sprint race went unpunished by Formula 1's stewards, who declared "both drivers had contributed to the incident."

articles.title: Verstappen beats Ferraris to Singapore pole
articles.description: Red Bull's Max Verstappen beats the Ferraris of Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton to pole position in qualifying at the Singapore Grand Prix.
